description: Custom Cards represent individual machine assets. They display an asset number and value, with fully customizable font size. The visual is ideal for dashboards that present equipment status or performance metrics. Page tooltips are supported for enhanced interactivity, and right-click actions enable drill-through navigation. Asset selection is intentionally disabled, which prevents the visual from interacting with other visuals. This design ensures that when many assets are displayed on a production line, clicking an asset will not filter or alter data elsewhere on the report. The visual will always present consistent information regardless of user interactions.
